title: No Comment (Sing It Back)
style: funk-soul, 96 BPM, sing-along-able, deliberately non-threatening, TR-808 with brushed snare on the offbeat, soul horn stabs, single male lead with female backing on the hook
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Officer, I see you
I see your badge, I see your gun
I'm not running, not resisting
I'm just gonna sing till we're done

[Pre-chorus]
You can ask me anything
I have the right to choose
What I say, what I don't
That right's not mine to lose

[CHORUS]
No comment — I stand on the right
No comment — I'm not being rude tonight
No comment — my attorney's on the line
No comment — we can sing the rest of the time
(Backing): No-com-ment / no-com-ment / sing it back

[Verse 2]
You don't have to like it
I don't have to explain
I'm not the first one to use it
I won't be the last one again

[CHORUS]
No comment — I stand on the right
No comment — I'm not being rude tonight
No comment — my attorney's on the line
No comment — we can sing the rest of the time

[Bridge — slow, almost spoken]
No comment doesn't mean guilty
No comment doesn't mean sad
No comment means I know my rights
And I'm not gonna make this bad

[CHORUS final — both voices]
No comment — sing it back to me, officer
No comment — let's both breathe

[Outro]
Just breathe · just breathe · just breathe
No comment.
